purpose: Close v7r1 Step3 same-object, Owner wake impersonation, and build-time Python actual-use blockers while enforcing pre-Lab assembly integrity.

blocker_closure_contract.python_build_actual_use: Docker build must run fd-bound isolated Python, import/probe PyNaCl, enumerate imported modules and /proc/self/maps, and require exact manifest identity for every actual file.
blocker_closure_contract.step3_same_object: Producer once-opens and authenticates exact Step3 bytes and retains that object; reviewed POST_OAUTH_ONLY runner consumes the same fd and a private socketpair to the frozen step3-preflight control service without pathname reopen.
blocker_closure_contract.owner_trigger: No UID1000-owned public wake socket or public literal. Producer creates a private one-shot socketpair, passes child endpoint only to a dedicated-UID non-dumpable/no-new-privs reviewed trigger, and Owner performs only one newline on inherited platform TTY. legacy_tiocsti must be root-controlled and disabled.
